# Bundled fonts

The app's type follows the DataNodes web app (`frontend/src/theme.css`): mono for you and every
number, model and id; a Charter-like serif for Otto's answers.

| File in `app/src/main/res/font/` | Font | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ibm_plex_mono_regular.ttf`, `ibm_plex_mono_semibold.ttf` | IBM Plex Mono 2.005 (Regular, SemiBold) | github.com/IBM/plex, `packages/plex-mono/fonts/complete/ttf` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt` |
| `charis_sil_regular.ttf` | Charis SIL 6.200 (Regular) | software.sil.org/charis, `CharisSIL-6.200.zip` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 — `CharisSIL-OFL.txt` |
